as_told.title: Puthoff's Physical Review paper on gravity

plain: A physicist named Hal Puthoff, described on the show as a CIA-linked UFO expert, says he published a paper in a physics journal describing what he calls a polarizable vacuum approach to gravity. The idea treats empty space as something that can be stretched or polarized, a bit like a material, and Puthoff says it reproduces all the standard tests of general relativity, Einstein's theory of gravity. If he is right, it would give a different way of understanding how gravity works.
